title: Jungian type indicator (32 items)
label: JUNGIAN TYPE / 32 ITEMS
tagline: Four dichotomies. Thirty-two questions. One model's answers.
source: written for this playground; not a validated instrument and not the MBTI
prompt: rate how accurately this describes you:

results.description: The answers favor reflection, quiet, and a small circle over group interaction.
The answers favor group interaction, thinking out loud, and an active social role.
The answers favor concrete facts, experience, and practical, proven methods.
The answers favor patterns, possibilities, and the big picture over present facts.
The answers favor logic, objectivity, and direct criticism over harmony.
The answers favor harmony, empathy, and the impact of decisions on people.
The answers favor plans, early decisions, and finishing ahead of deadlines.
The answers favor open options, adapting as things unfold, and flexible schedules.
